comment: THIS FILE IS AUTO-LOADED. Do NOT add a `hooks` field to plugin.json pointing at it — the standard hooks/hooks.json is discovered automatically, and referencing it as well registers it twice and fails the ENTIRE plugin load with 'Duplicate hooks file detected'. Confirmed against CLI 2.1.246: the plugin installed but reported 'failed to load' and contributed no skills at all. manifest.hooks is only for ADDITIONAL hook files. ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} is exported to hook processes and is quoted because the plugin cache path can contain spaces. The hook never blocks — see spec-guard.mjs.
